ext_name.message: SkinSniper - CS2 Skin Price Checker for Steam
ext_name.description: Extension name shown in the store and browser UI. Chrome Web Store hard limit: 45 characters. If no natural translation fits, keep the English name.

ext_description.message: CS2 skin price checker on Steam Market and inventories: marketplace prices in a small panel. No Steam requests, no interface bloat.
ext_description.description: Manifest description, doubles as the store summary. Chrome Web Store hard limit: 132 characters.

popup_settings.description: Tooltip of the gear button in the popup header.

popup_back_to_search.description: Gear button tooltip while the settings card is open.

popup_search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the popup search box. Items are non-skin CS2 items (cases, stickers, charms...).

popup_panel_position.description: Settings row label for the screen-corner picker of the floating price panel.

popup_lang_currency.description: Settings row label; the value next to it shows e.g. 'EN · USD'.

popup_change.description: Link next to the language/currency value; opens the settings page on skinsniper.com.

popup_prefs_hint.message: Both follow what you picked on skinsniper.com.
popup_prefs_hint.description: Hint under the settings rows: the panel's language and currency come from the user's choice on the website.

popup_markets.description: Settings section heading above the list of marketplaces.

popup_markets_hint.message: Starred markets sit on top of the price panel. Hidden ones never show up.
popup_markets_hint.description: Hint under the marketplace heading, explaining what the star and the eye do.

popup_market_pin.description: Star button tooltip in the settings list: pins the market to the top of the price panel.

popup_market_unpin.description: Star button tooltip when the market is already pinned.

popup_market_hide.description: Eye button tooltip in the settings list: the market stops showing up in the panel.

popup_market_show.description: Eye button tooltip when the market is currently hidden.

popup_link_inventory_value.description: Popup footer link to the inventory value calculator tool.

popup_link_trade_up.description: Popup footer link to the trade-up calculator. Trade-up is the CS2 trade up contract; use the term the local CS2 community uses.

popup_link_price_comparison.description: Popup footer link to the marketplace price comparison tool.

popup_no_access.message: SkinSniper cannot read Steam pages or reach its own site, so no prices load.
popup_no_access.description: Banner shown when the browser has the extension's site access switched off (mainly Firefox).

access_turn_on.description: Button asking the browser to grant site access back. Used in the popup banner and in the Steam page panel.

popup_access_granted.message: Access is on. Reload the Steam page to see the panel.
popup_access_granted.description: Shown after the user grants access.

popup_access_still_off.description: Shown when the permission prompt was declined. popup_manual_hint is appended after it.

popup_access_no_prompt.message: Access cannot be asked for here.
popup_access_no_prompt.description: Shown when the browser refuses to show a permission prompt. popup_manual_hint is appended after it.

popup_manual_hint.message: Open the extensions button in the toolbar, pick SkinSniper and allow the sites there.
popup_manual_hint.description: How to grant site access manually via the browser's extensions toolbar menu.

popup_on_this_page.description: Label under the item that the current Steam tab is showing.

popup_more_results.description: Link under a search section; opens the full result list on the site. $COUNT$ is the total number of results.

section_skins.description: Search result section heading. Matches the site's nav wording.

section_items.description: Search result section heading. Matches the site's nav wording.

section_collections.description: Search result section heading. Matches the site's nav wording.

section_families.description: Search result section heading: a skin across all its wear conditions.

section_phases.description: Search result section heading: Doppler-style phase variants.

section_updates.description: Search result section heading: CS2 game updates covered on the site.

panel_cheapest_condition.description: Label above the price rows when the panel aggregates a whole skin family and shows its cheapest wear condition (exterior).

panel_not_in_catalog.message: Not in the SkinSniper catalog yet
panel_not_in_catalog.description: Shown when the item on the Steam page is unknown to the catalog.

panel_search_on_skinsniper.description: Button under the unknown-item note; opens the site search for the item's name.

panel_no_site_access.message: SkinSniper has no access to its own site
panel_no_site_access.description: Shown in the panel when the browser has the extension's site access switched off, so API calls are blocked.

panel_api_error.description: Shown when the price request failed (offline, server error).

panel_try_again.description: Retry button under the error note.

panel_cheaper_than_steam.description: Tooltip on the discount badge next to a marketplace price. $PCT$ is a whole number.

panel_no_prices.description: Shown when the item is known but no marketplace currently lists it.

panel_pin_market.message: Pin this market to the top
panel_pin_market.description: Tooltip on the market's colour dot in the price panel; clicking it pins the market to the top.

panel_unpin_market.description: Tooltip on the dot when the market is already pinned to the top.

panel_markets_all_hidden.message: Every market is hidden in the settings
panel_markets_all_hidden.description: Shown instead of the price rows when the user hid every marketplace in the extension settings.

panel_more_markets_one.description: Button revealing one hidden marketplace price row.

panel_more_markets.description: Button revealing hidden marketplace price rows. $COUNT$ is always 2 or more. Phrase it so it is grammatical for ANY count from 2 up in your language; if plural forms differ by number (e.g. Polish), use a numeral-neutral phrasing such as 'show $COUNT$ more'.

panel_mini_title.description: Tooltip on the collapsed panel's small logo button.

panel_collapse.description: Tooltip on the panel close button; collapses the panel to a small logo.

panel_settings_title.description: Tooltip on the panel gear button; opens the popup on the settings card.

panel_check_skin.description: Bottom CTA linking the skin's page on skinsniper.com.

panel_check_item.description: Bottom CTA linking the item's page on skinsniper.com.
